Nucleus: RNR copies R707 / R709 / R711 / R1914, UMP kinase R782 and the nucleotide diffusions (UM11, all blocked); dUDP exit R1104 / R789 active; purple = the what-if thioredoxin links (Option A, NOT in the model)
Cytosol: the active RNR copies (same GPRs), thioredoxin reductase R755, UMP kinase R781 and the NTP reductases R702-R705 (thioredoxin gene only)

Nothing in the model was changed (user decision B). Reaction colour = scenario value: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 % on Task A + PO1f, uracil open, R612 closed; Gurobi 1e-9); pFBA = flux at the optimum. The what-if is an in-memory test that was NOT implemented.

Node colour (Task A, whole-model FVA): dark red, large = the two census roots, TRX1 [nu] (RNP, no producer) and TRX1-disulphide [nu] (RNC, no consumer); blue = every reaction blocked as built, not in the what-if; orange = blocked in both; grey = has an unblocked reaction. Repeated nodes are the same pool. Layout is automatic.
AS BUILT: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 %), Task A + PO1f. Every UM11 reaction is 0
